sources.quote: Supplier: Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C). Opened 2025-03-20. Status: open.

cracks around fastening holes on brackets machined from EN AW-6082 material delivered by
the supplier; found at incoming inspection on BR-310.

findings.why: BR-310 is made of EN AW-6082-T5 supplied by Chisone (SUP-C). The 8D on cracking in that 6082 material is still open, with root cause under investigation and corrective action not yet verified. The packing change itself is covered by DEV-125, which is valid until 2027-01-31, and APR-003 approves SUP-C for BR-310 at PLT-PIN for CUST-NOR. The open 8D on the part's alloy still applies.
